root.name: management-file-read
root.statusTransitionRule: draft->proposed requires complete inventory + complete no-placeholder proposed fixtures + static harness; proposed->observed requires real Go producer bytes per variant (v0 observed now; v1 observed at R1.11); observed->frozen requires codec + state + resource gates proven.
root.canonicalOwner: macbridge (docs/protocol/samples/management-file-read/ is the ONLY copy; NOT synced to iOS — iOS does not consume the Management API)

producerConsumers.producer: go-bridge ManagementServer (go-bridge/management_api.go handleStatus today; future R1.11 quiesce/commit/abort handlers)
consumers: macbridge Mac Swift (ManagementStatus + future RuntimeManager / RuntimeProcessController)

root.scopeNote: Mac-local Management API (/internal/status, future /internal/runtime/quiesce, commit-quiesced-shutdown, abort-quiesce). Distinct from the cross-repo Bridge/Relay wire root and from the iOS JSC/artifact root. Per plan §3.6 sample-owner rules.

numericDomainRules.integerToken: all numeric fields must be base-10 JSON integer tokens; reject negative, float, exponent, quoted-number, null, overflow
numericDomainRules.stateEpoch: UInt64, starts at 1, increments by exactly 1 on each FileReadHealth state transition; never wraps; overflow = fail-closed
numericDomainRules.quiesceEpoch: UInt64, starts at 1, increments by exactly 1 on each accepted quiesce operation; never wraps
numericDomainRules.healthEpoch: UInt64 echo of current stateEpoch at observation time; expectedHealthEpoch compared against it; no third counter
numericDomainRules.stuckWorkers: UInt32 protocol domain, bounded by A0 poolSize
numericDomainRules.activeTurns: UInt32 protocol domain, bounded by A0 maxBridgeOwnedActiveTurns
numericDomainRules.pendingInteractions: UInt32 protocol domain, bounded by A0 maxPendingInteractions

operationId.encoding: 16 random bytes encoded as exactly 32 lowercase ASCII hex characters
operationId.role: opaque correlation; may be hash-map key; NOT constant-time (not a secret)

token.encoding: 16 random bytes encoded as exactly 32 lowercase ASCII hex characters
token.comparison: constant-time byte comparison after hex-decode to 16 raw bytes
token.redactionRule: token MUST NOT appear in OSLog, Go log, stdout/stderr, metrics, support info, crash annotation, or status; fixtures use fixed non-production test token only
token.macLifetime: Mac holds token only within current operation object; cleared on commit/abort/terminal, generation teardown, or sleep/wake invalidation

idAndTokenSecurityDomain.decoderRule: strict decoder rejects wrong length, uppercase, non-ASCII, or non-hex BEFORE entering business lock

timeBudgetInequalities.checkedArithmetic: all additions use checked arithmetic; any overflow fails the config gate
timeBudgetInequalities.valuesFrozenAt: A0.5 (pending numeric freeze); schema stays draft until values frozen

variants.name: v0-status
variants.observedVia: real Go handleStatus (go-bridge/management_api.go) with deterministic non-sensitive test config + injected fixed clock
consumers: macbridge Mac Swift ManagementStatus (v0 lenient decoder)
variants.notes: R11 §2.1 live key/type dump confirmed 5 string fields, no iosPort. iosPort is Mac Swift model optional only; must NOT be written into v0 producer fixture.

variants.name: quiesce-request
variants.notes: POST /internal/runtime/quiesce; exact fields managementSchemaVersion:1, operationId, expectedRuntime{pid,bridgeEpoch}, expectedHealthEpoch; Mac RNG failure => request not sent

variants.name: quiesce-already-quiescing
variants.notes: active different operation; no token leaked

variants.name: quiesce-operation-reused
variants.notes: operationId hit last-terminal (incl just-expired active); no new lease; forces new ID

variants.name: commit-request
variants.notes: POST /internal/runtime/commit-quiesced-shutdown; exact: managementSchemaVersion:1, operationId, expectedRuntime, expectedHealthEpoch, quiesceEpoch, token

variants.name: commit-committed
variants.notes: outcome=committed + runtimeIdentity,healthEpoch,quiesceEpoch; Go atomic quiescing->shuttingDown then graceful self-exit regardless of response delivery

variants.name: commit-quiesce-mismatch
variants.notes: operationId relation or quiesceEpoch wrong; no state change

variants.name: commit-token-mismatch
variants.notes: same operation+epoch but token wrong; constant-time compare; no state change

variants.name: commit-lease-expired
variants.notes: now >= expiresAt; same lock restores accepting + writes expired terminal

variants.name: error-runtime-quiescing
variants.notes: Bridge-owned admission rejects new turn/question/permission/file while quiescing

variants.name: error-file-read-degraded
variants.notes: FileReadHealth degraded; stuck workers; not retried until management health recovers + re-handshake

variants.name: supervisor-pending
variants.notes: multiple restart reasons merge into single pending intent

variants.name: supervisor-restartFailed
variants.notes: retains failure evidence; manual retry on same serialized coordinator; never launch 2nd runtime

commitAtomicCommitAbortTable.sourceRef: plan §3.6.3 commit/abort全函数与判定优先级
commitAtomicCommitAbortTable.rule: strict codec/auth before business lock; within lock, first lock-acquirer linearizes; mismatch never mutates state; lease live only when now < expiresAt (now==expiresAt is expired)
commitAtomicCommitAbortTable.coveredByTest: go-bridge management admission table-driven + fake-clock test (a1-mgmt-state-tests)
